fields.description:
When a job in the Gerrit Verified Gate is cancelled or times out, the gate casts `Verified -1`
with a message that is exactly `CANCELLED: <run URL>`. It names no job, gives no reason, and
does not say whether the run failed a test, was superseded, or hit a job timeout. An operator
or agent triaging the change has to open the run and inspect job conclusions by hand to learn
anything at all.

This is OBSERVABILITY ONLY. When the gate votes +1 or -1 must not change; only what the -1
message carries.

## Why the message is empty today

`.github/workflows/gerrit-verify.yaml`'s `vote` job casts the label with
`lfreleng-actions/gerrit-review-action`. That action builds its message itself:

    MESSAGE="${STATUS}: ${SERVER_URL}/${REPOSITORY}/actions/runs/${RUN_ID}"

It exposes no input for custom text. Verified both at the pinned SHA
(a1c036a59b94c8ab89de26d378f6a28cc7378b13, v1.1.2) and on the action's current main; v1.1.2 is
the latest tag, so there is no upstream version to bump to. Its inputs are host, port,
username, key, key_name, known_hosts, gerrit-change-number, gerrit-patchset-number, vote-type,
comment-only. The vote message therefore cannot be enriched in place, and the detail must be
posted as an ADDITIONAL comment-only review on the same patchset.

## Evidence this bites

Confirmed cancel/timeout -1s that carried no signal:

- Runs 31560638673 and 31562494026: the `bounded mutation gate` job hit `timeout-minutes: 30`
  (check-run annotation "The job has exceeded the maximum execution time of 30m0s"). Gerrit
  showed only `CANCELLED: <url>`.
- Runs 31563192064 and 31563305610: the `select mutation shards` step failed with
  `mutation_gate.py: error: argument command: invalid choice: 'select'` (patchset predates
  ac0f62be). Again no signal in the vote.

Two different causes, one indistinguishable message.

## Approach

1. Add `scripts/summarize_ci_failures.py`, a trusted script with a pure `summarize()` function
   mapping a GitHub list-jobs payload plus check-run annotations to a short triage summary:
   one line per non-successful job giving the job name, whether it TIMED OUT (annotation
   "exceeded the maximum execution time") versus was cancelled or failed, its duration, and
   its `html_url`.
2. In `vote`, when the normalized vote-type is not `success`, run that script over this run's
   jobs and post the result to Gerrit as a comment-only review (no labels).

The script is checked out from the default branch via the existing trusted sparse-checkout,
the same trust model as `scripts/normalize_ci_conclusion.py` — patchset-controlled code never
runs in the vote job.

## Files

- `.github/workflows/gerrit-verify.yaml` (vote job: add summary + comment step; extend the
  sparse-checkout list; add `checks: read` for the annotations read)
- `scripts/summarize_ci_failures.py` (new)
- `tests/scripts/test_summarize_ci_failures.py` (new)

Deliberately does NOT touch `.github/workflows/_mutation.yml` or
`tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py` — Gerrit change 1627 owns those.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] AC1: `summarize()` given a jobs payload containing a job whose annotation says it
      exceeded its maximum execution time renders that job as timed out, naming the job and
      its duration; a unit test asserts the rendered text.
- [ ] AC2: `summarize()` distinguishes the three non-success outcomes — timed out, cancelled
      without a timeout annotation, and failed — with different wording; unit tests cover all
      three.
- [ ] AC3: `summarize()` given a payload where every job succeeded returns an empty string, so
      a `Verified +1` run posts no extra comment; asserted by a unit test.
- [ ] AC4: the vote job posts the summary to Gerrit as a comment-only review, cast with no
      Verified or Code-Review label, and only when the normalized vote-type is not `success`.
      Asserted by a test parsing `gerrit-verify.yaml` for a step using
      `comment-only: true` guarded on the vote-type.
- [ ] AC5: the vote-type fed to the existing cast step is byte-identical to today's — the
      `normalize` step and its inputs are unchanged. Asserted by a test that the cast step's
      `vote-type` expression still reads `steps.normalize.outputs.vote-type`.
- [ ] AC6: `scripts/check_verify_gate_parity.py` still passes, i.e. `vote.needs` is unchanged.

## Verification

    python -m pytest tests/scripts/test_summarize_ci_failures.py -q
    python scripts/check_verify_gate_parity.py
    make lint && make typecheck
fields.title: Verified -1 from a cancelled or timed-out job carries no triage signal
